profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Disney
profile.summary:
Hello! I’m a seasoned Software Engineer who’s worked in multiple industries including fintech, e-commerce, education, and creative agencies, building high traffic web applications, bringing data to life with visually engaging user experiences. 

I’ve had multiple years of experience working with modern JS frameworks, JavaScript fundamentals, and data visualization in collaborative environments striving to deliver meaningful features to users as efficiently as possible.

Even though my strength leans toward the frontend stack, I also have experience working building internal product apis, and data ingestion services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing multiple large scale Market Analytics applications used by various large clients in the Financial Tech sector for global market analysis, merger and acquisitions, and finance-driven intel.

- Responsible for leading architecture/development of new UI workflows and features
- contributing to component libraries shared throughout all products within the company
- contributing to developing internal product apis, and Opensearch data ingestion tools
- maintaining testing, coding standards, and up to date analytics tracking on applications
positions.insights: Skills: Elasticsearch · React.js · Jest · User Experience (UX) · TypeScript · Next.js · Node.js · AWS Lambda · Data Visualization · Opensearch

positions.title: Software Engineer (UI)
positions.description:
- Worked with major banking stakeholders and designers to build a collaborative assets management app, replacing a bank’s single user Excel-driven workflow using React, Typescript, NodeJS, D3, AgGrid
- Developed the UI for securely conducting bond investments on high-traffic web apps for a major banking client, bringing in 30k new users
- Provided frontend architecture consulting tailored to each client's tech stack, optimizing for scalability and maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Visualization · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer (UI Developer)
positions.description:
Collaborating with a team of developers and user-experience designers to build user interfaces for enterprise financial applications. Tracking customer information, billing info, and exporting transactions

Lead front-end development on stand alone venture financial visualization project. 
Researching visual libraries, and played role as architect to build codebase from the ground up, with build processes, continuous integration, testing to meet current standards, and own library of components that can be shared with projects in other lines of business

Responsibilities include:
- Collaborating with designers to meet UX standards with every implementation
- Estimating effort needed between team member to complete work
- Advise and give feedback on any Front End issues relating to implementation, timing, and feasibility.
- Improve testing coverage on front-end codebase.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Frontend)
positions.description:
Front-end development on web applications and interactive experiences for various clients, working closely with UX/Visual designers, and back-end teams.

Played an active role, in prototyping concepts, and consulting with clients on web applications that drive up to over 100k users weekly

Client Projects:
- Michael Kors
- VOYA
- Petco
- BYSO
- Keurig
- Adclub Brandathon

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer/Designer
positions.description: Develop and design websites, web applications and user interfaces for different services.

positions.title: Multimedia Programmer
positions.description:
Develop, test, and modernize multimedia applications/interactive educational course-ware meeting the higher demand of mobile device over desktop usage in middle-school classrooms

Contributed to the development and design of the user interface for the education 
management web portal used by customers.
